title: BehaviorWorldGen: Closing the Loop between Action Models and World Simulators via Controllable Behavior-Aware Structured World Generation

control_signal.value: Frame-level meta-actions per agent (keep lane, change lane, turn) plus lifecycle constraints on agent composition; target meta-actions are derived from the action model's diagnosed failure cases.

control_mechanism.value: Autoregressive model over agent lifecycles, meta-actions and states; specified lifecycle/meta-action variables are fixed as interventions and all unconstrained variables, including surrounding agents, are generated jointly.

base_model.value: BehaviorFlow, an autoregressive traffic-flow model (lifecycle, meta-action, state factors), feeding a Cosmos-based DiT action-conditioned world model trained with rectified flow and distilled to a causal model.

datasets.value: World model evaluated on a private dataset; action models trained on 85K NAVSIM training samples plus 16K synthetic samples, evaluated on NAVSIM.

metrics.value: World model: FID, FVD, generation speed. Policy: NAVSIM PDMS with NC, DAC, EP, TTC and Comf. components.

controllability_evidence.value: Qualitative: from one initial scene, different meta-action edits give distinct following, avoidance and yielding variants (three lane-change variants, two intersection yielding orders). Downstream: ReCogDrive PDMS rises to 87.3 (+0.8); DiffusionDrive 87.7 to 88.6.

notes: Controllability is shown only qualitatively in the packet, with no quantitative control-accuracy metric; the PDMS gains measure downstream policy improvement, not control fidelity. Paper is mainly a data-generation loop for action-model refinement.
